svg.text: Two 16-key replicas compare root hashes, recurse only into differing subtrees, then transfer divergent leaves
Divergence: k05 modified · k14 absent on A / extra on B

text.tspan: Compare root → range hashes → pair hashes → individual keys; exchange only the divergent values / tombstones.
All 16 key positions are shown per replica; the highlighted ranges guide recursive comparison.

svg.text: Illustrative tree layout. Hash collisions are assumed negligibly unlikely; bucket boundaries and rebuild policy are implementation-specific.
